description: This file defines the ContentType class within a Markdown content handling namespace, responsible for converting Markdown to HTML, managing caching, and handling configuration.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Handles Markdown content conversion, caching, and configuration integration within the Daux documentation generator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ContentType with a given configuration object.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a new CommonMarkConverter instance with current configuration.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Returns the cached converter instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns supported file extensions for this content type ('md', 'markdown').

methods.name: doConversion
methods.description: Performs the markdown to HTML conversion and logs the process.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts raw markdown input to HTML, utilizing caching when possible, and associates content with a node.
